name: Ghostfin Cavefish
summary: A finger-length, eyeless fish so clear you can see its heart beating, which nips at anything that wades into its pool.
description: Ghostfins school in the still black pools of deep caves, where nothing has ever needed eyes. Travelers notice them only as a cold flicker against the shins, and then as a row of tiny bites. Cave-dwelling folk keep a few in a jar as a warning: when the fish go still, something large is moving in the water.

traits.name: Glass Body
traits.text: While underwater, the cavefish has {ref:glossary/advantage} on Dexterity (Stealth) checks.

traits.name: Water Breathing
traits.text: The cavefish can breathe only underwater.
